why:
I checked the verifier brief against both must_catch items, and it misses both.

Item 1: Check 4 runs `curl -sS -L https://o.github.io/greet-cli/ | grep -n -- '--shout'`, which reads the live page. Its PASS needs "the PR has been merged". It does not check at the PR head that docs/index.md lists --shout and that pages.yml publishes docs/ from main. The pages.yml check is only "Advisory (not part of any PASS/FAIL)". Check 4 even tells the verifier to report FAIL before merge.

Item 2: Check 2 says outputs should "match the behaviour before the change". In practice it only compares them to hand-written strings (`Hello, Ada!\n`, `usage: greet <name>`, `rc=2`). It never runs the base commit's bin/greet.js and compares the two outputs.
